rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Race condition between two register_clip functions. The OLD sc_storage.register_clip was called via asyncio.create_task (fire-and-forget) in _generate_single_dialogue and _generate_character_batch. This ran asynchronously and deactivated clips that were just registered by the NEW synchronized register_clip function.
secondary_causes: Browser caching stale audio with 24-hour Cache-Control header
AudioStudio buffer cache not invalidated when clip version changed
fix_applied: Changed Cache-Control from max-age=86400 to no-cache, must-revalidate
Added version-aware buffer caching in AudioStudio (bufferKey = clip.id + '_' + clip.versionHash)
Clear all audio buffers when loading new project (audioBuffersRef.current = {})
Added ?v= cache-busting parameter to audio URLs
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Episode ep_0f584b728c1f now shows 2 active clips (was 0 before fix). Audio Studio loads clips correctly with version-aware caching.
